about: Which model families count as class lean (R-ROUTING, Model classes). Patterns are regular expressions matched against the model name the agent reports in its hook input, case-insensitive. Every model that matches nothing is class standard, so a stale table costs tokens, never safety. Add a family only on evidence (a retro, the model bench) or on the user's word. A project overrides the table with a line 'Model class: lean' or 'Model class: standard' under Project specifics in AGENTS.md.
